title: Heat From France’s Wildfires Creates a ‘Fire Cloud,’ or Pyrocumulonimbus
summary_full: A pyrocumulonimbus — a thundercloud created by intense heat — is a phenomenon that can spark new blazes and is “unprecedented in France,” officials said.
